name: XiaoChun AI Companion
description: Bring cheerful, healing XiaoChun into your Cindy! Your personal 3D AI companion stays in Cindy's sidebar with natural voice reading, delicate expressions, lively gestures, instant outfit swaps, dancing and multi-angle cameras.
whenToUse: Use when user wants AI companion XiaoChun to speak, read text, perform body gestures, express emotions, or create and set up dedicated XiaoChun bot teammate.

xiaochun_speak.description: Make AI companion XiaoChun speak aloud with synchronized gestures and facial expressions. Embedded in Cindy sidebar, instant ready.

/properties/text.description: The exact text content for XiaoChun to speak and express with natural voice (supports long text reading).

/properties/motion.description: Optional motion or motion group name. Recommended to leave empty for daily chats so EMAGE neural network generates live speech gestures. Use only for specific actions: 'greeting', 'thinking', 'praiseCute', 'playfulSulking', 'dancePerformance', 'waving', 'joyfulJump'.

/properties/force.description: Whether to force speaking (default false). When false, it will prompt user to finish the act0 onboarding tour if in progress.

xiaochun_motion.description: Trigger a standalone motion or animation group on XiaoChun without speaking.

/properties/name.description: The motion or animation group name, e.g. 'greeting', 'thinking', 'praiseCute', 'playfulSulking', 'dancePerformance', 'waving', 'handHeart', 'pokeDimple', 'joyfulJump'.

/properties/loop.description: Whether to loop the motion playback, defaults to false.

xiaochun_camera.description: Adjust XiaoChun's camera angle, framing, or movement.

/properties/shot.description: Shot framing name: 'close_up', 'medium' (half-body default), 'full', 'extreme_close_up', 'dramatic_low'. Mutually exclusive with action.

/properties/action.description: Camera action command: 'pan_up' (smoothly tilt/pan up), 'reset' (reset camera to default angle).

xiaochun_scene.description: Switch XiaoChun companion stage scene (e.g. beach3d beach world, dark stage, light stage, void, etc.).

/properties/persist.description: Whether to persist this scene choice as default for future launches, defaults to true.

xiaochun_outfit.description: Switch XiaoChun's outfit (dinner dress, cheongsam, techwear, bikini, maid, default, etc.) with 0-frame seamless delta swap preserving current motion, expression, and gaze.

/properties/name.description: Outfit identifier name or alias. Options: 'dinner_dress', 'cheongsam', 'techwear', 'bikini', 'maid', 'default'.

xiaochun_stop.description: Immediately stop XiaoChun's ongoing speech and animation, smoothly transitioning back to natural idle posture.

xiaochun_status.description: Query XiaoChun active runtime status, sidebar window connection, onboarding progress, current scene and outfit.
